The '''Samhar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Samhar]], which was inhabited by the [[Samhari]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Atlas Extra" />
